title: Sarah Case
text:
I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Political Science at Florida State University. I study American politics and political behavior, with a focus on American elections, voter confidence, and post-election audits. I currently teach American National Government.
Before starting my Ph.D. at FSU, I earned a B.A. in Political Science with a minor in sociology (2021) and an M.A. in Political Science (2024), both from the University of Central Florida. I also hold an M.S. in Political Science from Florida State University.

text: I teach a course in American politics.

title: Research
text: My research examines American elections, voter confidence, and how post-election audits are tools to influence voter confidence. A complete list is on my CV.
